sql:
SELECT AVG(d.A15) 
FROM district d 
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id 
WHERE d.A15 > 4000 AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM account 
    WHERE district_id = d.district_id AND date >= '1997-01-01'
) 
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM account 
    WHERE district_id = d.district_id AND date >= '1997-01-01'
)
